## Mapping Decisions

- The source already arrives in Senzing JSON; the mapping routes values verbatim (verbatim check passes).
- Input is the DOB-normalized copy from the Phase 1 improve path (data/raw/screening_list-improved.jsonl); the original data/raw/screening_list.jsonl is unchanged.
- RECORD_TYPE comes from each record's own FEATURES.RECORD_TYPE (PERSON on all 17).
- Single-string names (4, including Arabic and Cyrillic) stay in NAME_FULL, unparsed; Senzing is UTF-8 and compares names across scripts.
- ADDR_LINE1 values that hold a whole address are kept as-is; Senzing's quickstart example shows the same form.
- LIST_TYPE, LIST_STATUS and LISTED_DATE are payload for screening review; none collides with a reserved attribute.
